name: Captain Carter
appearance: Young militia captain, fair-brown hair, open friendly face; scarlet regimentals with gold epaulettes, crimson sash, tall boots.
definition: Officer of the militia quartered at Meryton (canon ch. 7). Cuts in at the assembly to ask Miss Frost for the set — and is told by Mr Darcy that the lady is engaged.
voice: Easy, cheerful, a soldier's plainness; admits he dances badly.
